preconditions.description: The input string s has length between 1 and 10^5 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'bw' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s consists only of characters 'b' and 'w'.

postconditions.expression: isinstance(return_value, int) and return_value >= 1 and return_value <= len(s)
postconditions.description: The output is an integer between 1 and the length of the input string.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(1, sum(1 for i in range(len(s)-1) if s[i] != s[i+1]) + 1 if any(s[i] != s[i+1] for i in range(len(s)-1)) else 1)
postconditions.description: The output equals the maximum possible length of a contiguous alternating subsequence achievable by any number of split-reverse operations, which is equivalent to the length of the longest alternating run in the original string if no operations help, or the total count of color changes plus one if the string is not monochromatic, effectively allowing the construction of a zebra of length equal to the number of alternating transitions plus one (capped by string length).
